template.name: AS/NZS 3760 In-service test - Class II
template.desc: In-service test of non-medical electrical equipment to AS/NZS 3760, not AS/NZS 3551: the limits are those of the CHS Ansur template “AS NZS 3760 - CL2.mtt”, kept as they were (the standard itself is not in the manuals folder, so they are unverified: for Jonathan to confirm). Steps and wording as in Ansur.

steps.title: Mains voltage
steps.instructions: Plug the ESA612 into the mains supply you are testing from.

steps.title: Insulation: mains to protective earth
steps.instructions: Connect the device’s mains lead to the ESA612 equipment outlet and switch the device on. Don’t touch the device during the test.

steps.title: Enclosure leakage
steps.instructions: Measure leakage from an exposed metal part to earth. If no exposed metal parts then shroud in tinfoil and measure leakage from shroud.
